name: Moving Camera
desc: Pans, tilts and tracking shots. The picture stops looking like a filmed stage play.

name: Continuity Editing
desc: Cross-cutting and close-ups that let a story flow from shot to shot.

name: Feature-Length Reels
desc: Multi-reel pictures an hour long or more. Unlocks Lavish and Epic budgets.

name: Fan Magazines
desc: Feed the public's hunger for stars. Unlocks the Press Campaign.

name: Studio Lighting
desc: Electric arc lamps replace daylight. Shoot moods, shadows and night scenes.

name: Synchronized Sound
desc: Talking pictures. Unlocks Musicals. Within a few years, silent films stop selling.

name: Radio Advertising
desc: Reach every living room in the country. Unlocks Radio Spots.

name: Three-Strip Colour
desc: Glorious full colour. Posters and pictures come alive.

name: Deep-Focus Lenses
desc: Everything sharp from foreground to horizon. Bolder compositions.

name: Magnetic Sound Recording
desc: Cleaner dialogue, richer scores and easier mixing.

name: Widescreen
desc: A picture too big for television. Spectacle is back.

name: Television Spots
desc: If you can't beat the little box, advertise on it. Unlocks TV Spots.

name: Lightweight Location Cameras
desc: Leave the soundstage and shoot in real streets.

name: Special Effects Workshop
desc: Miniatures, matte paintings and creatures built in-house.

name: Stereo Surround Sound
desc: Sound that moves around the theatre.

name: Saturation Release
desc: Open everywhere on the same weekend. Unlocks the Nationwide Blitz.

name: Stabilized Camera Rig
desc: Smooth handheld shots that glide through any space.
